question.worked_solution:
The table shows probabilities in the form $P(X\ge x).$ So first, we express the desired probability in this form:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\ge x) & =1-P(X\le x) \\  & =1-0.99 \\  & =0.01\end{aligned}
$$

Now, since $X∼{T}_{16},$ we focus on the row of the table that corresponds to $k=16.$

| $k∖p$ | $0.100$ | $0.050$ | $0.025$ | $0.010$ | $0.005$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $15$ | $1.341$ | $1.753$ | $2.131$ | $2.602$ | $2.947$ |
| $16$ | $1.337$ | $1.746$ | $2.120$ | $2.583$ | $2.921$ |
| $17$ | $1.333$ | $1.740$ | $2.110$ | $2.567$ | $2.898$ |

From this row, we see that

$$
P(X\ge 2.583)=0.010.
$$

Therefore, our answer is $x=2.583.$
